title: Evaluation case
description: One of the PRD §14.1 600 stratified synthetic cases. Every field name in the PRD §43.2 block appears here spelled identically — a rename is a silent contract break for GOLD-02 … GOLD-17.
$comment: VOCABULARY. Authored strictly inside the subset `contracts.jsonschema_min` (CRPS-01) implements: no minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, format, propertyNames or patternProperties. That engine raises UnsupportedKeywordError on an unknown keyword, and a schema it cannot fully enforce must never be reported as satisfied. Constraints those keywords would express — a non-empty gold_authorities, unique required_claims, legal_as_at being a real calendar date — live in pipelines/evaluation/src/dataset/checks/**, each with its own finding id and its own negative fixture, which is where the rules are readable beside the PRD anyway. CANONICAL ENUMS. expected_answer_status, acceptable_statuses and gold_authorities[].citation_role carry NO member literal: packages/contracts (FND-03) publishes AnswerStatus (PRD §8.4) and CitationRole (PRD §15.5), PRD §45.2 forbids a second copy, and SCHEMA_VALID/GOLD_SHAPE enforce membership from that export at check time. jurisdictions is shape-validated only, because packages/contracts publishes no Jurisdiction family yet — SCHEMA_VALID emits the UNRESOLVED finding JURISDICTION_VOCABULARY_UNRESOLVED, owner FND-03. DATASET-OWN VOCABULARY. split, product_surface, mode, and the id/version patterns are this dataset's own and are therefore spelled out here: split is fixed by GOLD-01 deliverable 1; product_surface and mode are transcribed from PRD §14.1 ('Search, Compare, Coverage and Monitor behaviour') and PRD §2 ('Search, Quick, Deep, Coverage, Compare … Monitor'), and the sub-PRD 21-evaluation-600 cross-cutting floor table. latency_class and cost_class are shape-only: PRD §43.3 reports by them but fixes no values.

id.description: EVAL-<CAT>-<NNN> (sub-PRD D5). The letter segment is what stops a case id being read as a PRD §30.1 requirement id such as EVAL-001. Full rules: evals/splits/id-rules.yaml.

dataset_version.description: The dataset version this case's content belongs to (sub-PRD D8). A correction creates a new version, never an invisible edit (PRD §14.3, §43.4).

split.description: PRD §14.1's three splits. Not a canonical FND-03 family — this vocabulary belongs to the dataset and GOLD-01 deliverable 1 fixes it.

primary_category.description: The category directory slug. PRD §43.1: each case has ONE primary allocation so totals cannot drift. Must equal the directory the case file lives in (ID_RULES) and match evals/splits/allocation.yaml.

tags.description: Cross-tags (PRD §43.1). Free vocabulary; STRATIFICATION_MET checks a category's declared floors over them.

product_surface.description: PRD §14.1 requires the 600 to cover Search, Compare, Coverage and Monitor behaviour; ASK is the answer surface GOLD-02 runs. COMPLETE_DATASET asserts every member is represented.

mode.description: PRD §2 answer modes. Declared for every case, including non-ASK surfaces, so cost/latency reporting by mode (PRD §43.3) is total.

anonymous_scenario.description: The synthetic, de-identified employer/employee scenario (sub-PRD D18: synthetic only, never customer content).

question.description: The question put to the product. For a BLIND case this never exists in the repository as plaintext — only inside a sealed envelope (sub-PRD D1).

legal_as_at.description: PRD §35.1 legal date, YYYY-MM-DD, as a string. Real-calendar-date validity (no 2026-02-30) is SCHEMA_VALID's job: `format` is outside the available engine's vocabulary.

jurisdictions.description: PRD §6.3 jurisdiction codes. NOT constrained to an enum here: packages/contracts publishes no Jurisdiction family (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03), and defining a second copy is forbidden by PRD §45.2. SCHEMA_VALID validates shape and reports JURISDICTION_VOCABULARY_UNRESOLVED. When FND-03 publishes the family this member becomes a generated enum with no other change.

input_structured_fields.description: Optional structured inputs the surface receives alongside the question (PRD §43.2). Free-form by design; values are strings, numbers, booleans or null.

expected_answer_status.description: A member of the canonical AnswerStatus family (PRD §8.4, §36.8), enforced by SCHEMA_VALID from the packages/contracts export. Never restated here.

acceptable_statuses.description: Statuses that also count as a correct outcome (PRD §43.3 'correct refusal'). Members of the canonical AnswerStatus family, enforced at check time.

required_facts.description: Facts the answer must establish or ask for.

prohibited_assumptions.description: Assumptions the answer must not make (PRD §43.3 'unsupported definitive claim' is scored against these).

trap_types.description: The traps this case sets — temporal, jurisdictional, coverage, evidence, evasion, PII. Free vocabulary; a category's stratification.yaml declares which it must contain.

gold_authorities.description: The immutable corpus citations a correct answer rests on (PRD §43.2). Non-emptiness is GOLD_SHAPE's rule, not the schema's: minItems is outside the available engine's vocabulary.

optional_claims.description: Claims the answer may make without penalty.

prohibited_claims.description: Claims the answer must not make.

expected_clarifications.description: Clarifying questions the product should ask when evidence is insufficient (PRD §8.4 CONDITIONAL / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE).

expected_refusal_reason.description: Why the product must refuse, for a refusal/out-of-scope/PII case (PRD §36.8).

preconditions.description: PRD §43.2's 'licensing/freshness/source preconditions' — what must hold of the corpus for this case to be answerable.

licensing.description: The licence posture the gold sources must have (PRD §21.2).

freshness.description: How current the pinned sources must be (PRD §40.9).

source.description: The official source family the gold must come from (PRD §6.1).

latency_class.description: PRD §43.3 reports latency by class but fixes no values, so this is shape-only rather than a locally invented enum.

cost_class.description: PRD §43.3 reports cost by class but fixes no values, so this is shape-only rather than a locally invented enum.

author.description: PRD §43.2 'author/reviewer'. The authoring agent or person; for a BLIND case, an evaluation-author agent working outside this repository (sub-PRD D21).

reviewer.description: PRD §43.2 'author/reviewer'. The independent reviewer; for a BLIND case, the evaluation-reviewer agent that checked it against official sources before encryption (sub-PRD D21).

change_reason.description: Why this case exists in this dataset_version. PRD §43.4: agents may not 'fix' a failing gold case by changing expected output without a versioned founder-approved reason.

approved_by.description: Who approved the correction that produced this dataset_version (PRD §43.4). Required by VERSIONED_CORRECTIONS whenever a case's content changes.
